title: Marker-free wrist RGB-D, truth-trained strain and patent-style adaptive fusion
scene: Same archived G1 plant and states. Deterministic, non-coded workshop textures on floor, gate and static room surfaces. No surveyed point list. Native plain-floor untextured scene serves as acquisition control on 241118-online_pause.
training: Existing 8 complete trajectories and 2 validation trajectories. Frozen four-channel virtual strain predictor. 3 reserved bench test motions. Simulator marker ground truth in training or scoring only.
calibration: 241118-online_pause for software and sizing. Held-out sessions: 241119 and 241120, both clock_pause and online_pause. All prior tagged results are development diagnostics, not SLAM or external confirmation.
capture: 25 Hz 480 x 360, 12 through 46 s. PX4 body attitude and CAD mount-camera chain, one neutral, initial-map alignment before 13.0s. Fixed shared 0.20s presentation latency. No truth or strain alignment of the SLAM trajectory. Report native computational timing separately.

conditions.occluded: Exact same source pixels, replace both RGB and depth by zeros for all captures 31.0 <= t < 35.0. Run actual SLAM independently. No filled poses after TRACK_LOST or map changes.

comparators: strain-only temporal filter with identical process model
metrics: wrapped plane error with >=5 deg estimated and reference magnitude, bilateral coverage
theta and bend-vector RMSE on shared timestamps
process: Simulation-only screening. No online retraining. No noise chosen after observing the held-out results. Preserve visual failure and report tradeoffs. Patented ideas modeled: confidence as observation variance, circular plane fusion, adaptive temporal filtering. Existing scalar project kernel retained as separate reference.
